source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: A psychic level 1 ability, usable once per battle round across your army. During your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), a Weirdboy unit that is not **battle-shocked** may make a **psychic roll** of one D6. If it does, a roll of 1 battle-shocks the unit, and regardless of the result the unit is placed into [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves) and gains [Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike).
